evals.prompt: I want to set up Doppler for my AI agent workspace to store Slack credentials locally without any cloud sync. How do I initialize the project and set my tokens?
evals.expected_output: Provides commands to create a local Doppler project, bind the local directory using doppler setup, and set secrets with doppler secrets set without configuring cloud sync.
expectations: Instructs creating a project using doppler projects create
Binds local directory to dev environment using doppler setup
Sets secret tokens using doppler secrets set
Warns against setting up cloud sync or exporting plaintext tokens to disk

evals.prompt: How do I run my Python agent script and configure an MCP server so they receive my Doppler credentials without writing a .env file to disk?
evals.expected_output: Explains using doppler run -- to inject environment variables into memory at runtime and shows configuring MCP server commands with doppler run.
expectations: Demonstrates runtime injection using doppler run -- <command>
Shows wrapping MCP server commands with doppler run
Emphasizes zero disk exposure and preventing plaintext tokens in git
